content.value_statement: Proxmox storage can become hard to track across nodes, pools, and workloads. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code review storage capacity, utilization, and expansion needs.
actual_capabilities: List storage devices across a Proxmox cluster.
Get storage devices for a specific Proxmox node.
Summarize capacity, free space, and utilization patterns.
Support storage expansion and upgrade planning.
Help identify storage bottlenecks and health concerns.
limitations: Requires connected Proxmox tooling that provides storage data.
Does not create or delete storage resources by itself.
Does not replace backup, RAID, or disaster recovery testing.
Recommendations depend on the quality of available metrics.

use_cases.title: Plan Cluster Storage Growth
use_cases.description: Review storage usage and free capacity before adding workloads or buying new disks.

use_cases.title: Monitor Node Storage Pressure
use_cases.description: Compare node-level storage usage to find capacity risks before they affect virtual machines.

use_cases.title: Prepare Storage Status Reports
use_cases.description: Create clear summaries of storage capacity, utilization, bottlenecks, and expansion needs.

prompt_templates.title: Show Cluster Capacity
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the storage-management skill to show all Proxmox storage devices, total capacity, used space, and free space.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Node
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the storage-management skill to review storage devices on the selected node and summarize utilization risks.

prompt_templates.title: Find Capacity Risks
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the storage-management skill to identify storage devices near capacity and recommend practical next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Build Expansion Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the storage-management skill to compare cluster storage usage, estimate growth pressure, and prepare an expansion plan.

output_examples.input: Show all storage devices and their capacity.
output_examples.output: A cluster storage summary with each device, capacity, used space, free space, and utilization percentage.

output_examples.input: Which node has the highest storage pressure?
output_examples.output: A node comparison that highlights the most constrained storage, likely causes, and recommended operational checks.
A planning summary covering current utilization, near-capacity devices, bottlenecks, and upgrade recommendations.

best_practices: Keep 20 to 30 percent free space for performance and maintenance.
Review node-level storage before placing large new workloads.
Validate redundancy, backups, and recovery processes outside this skill.
anti_patterns: Waiting until storage is almost full before planning expansion.
Moving workloads without checking node-specific storage pressure.
Treating capacity reports as a replacement for tested backups.

faq.question: What Proxmox storage tasks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports storage inventory, node-level review, utilization monitoring, troubleshooting, and expansion planning.

faq.question: Can it change storage configuration?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation describes analysis and reporting workflows, not direct storage changes.

faq.question: Which tools are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents get_storage for cluster storage and get_node_storage for node-specific storage.

faq.question: Can it detect storage bottlenecks?
faq.answer: It can help identify bottlenecks from available storage capacity, utilization, and performance information.

faq.question: Does it replace monitoring software?
faq.answer: No. It helps interpret storage information, but ongoing alerting should remain in monitoring systems.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is useful for Proxmox administrators, operations engineers, and IT managers who manage virtualization storage.
